titleEn: Create the first store (name, address, template)

undo.note: no: slug can change later only via support/redirect; store can be edited

en: How do I create my store?
Why is my store address taken?

steps: Onboarding wizard: store name, slug (checked live), template, then payment methods and go-live.
edgeCases: Slug with Arabic characters is transliterated/refused
Owner already at plan maxStores (Basic/Growth 1, Business 3)
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: Protected-slug claim and daily-cap lift are super-admin/contact-support only (audit gap 14)
No API to change the store slug after creation for the merchant (inferred)
